advert.what: Style and lyrics become a finished song with vocals - structure markers honoured ([Verse], [Chorus], [Guitar Solo]), a few minutes of audio, saved as a playable file. One run = one song; nothing stays running afterwards.

provider.name: YuE (YuE2-3B)
provider.note: yue-song.ps1 writes the request JSON the CLI wants, sets the env the model needs (PYTHONPATH, HF_HOME, expandable segments, UTF-8), runs "python -m yue2.cli generate" once, and copies audio.flac into the songs folder. No port, no server.
provider.update: git pull in C:/AI/YuE, reinstall into C:/AI/yue-venv; the launcher and the songs folder stay as they are

models.note: the xcodec that turns audio into tokens ships beside it in C:/AI/hf; the song file is a FLAC in the songs folder.

input.name: style
input.label: Style (genre, instruments, voice, BPM)
input.default: English, 1980s hard rock, arena rock anthem, distorted electric guitar riff, twin guitar harmonies, pounding drums, driving bass, high raspy male lead vocal, gang backing vocals, blistering guitar solo, analog tape warmth, 122 BPM, E minor
input.help: Everything about the sound lives here: genre, instruments, voice, BPM, key. The model reads it as one paragraph.

input.name: lyrics
input.label: Lyrics ([Verse] [Chorus] markers = song structure)
input.default:
[Verse]
There's a room down the hall with the door shut tight
Where the king of this house never sees the light
[Pre-Chorus]
He sold my back to the man in the hall
Now the devil's got a servant and the servant's got to crawl
[Chorus]
FRANK IS DANNY'S BITCH NOW - and the devil takes the rent
FRANK IS DANNY'S BITCH NOW - bow down, you're his again
[Guitar Solo]
[Outro]
Bitch now... FRANK IS DANNY'S BITCH NOW
input.help: Song length comes from the lyrics: there is no seconds field. Roughly 2.5-3 s of audio per line; [Guitar Solo] / [Instrumental Break] / [Outro] add time without words.

input.name: seed
input.label: Seed
input.help: Same seed and same words make the same take. Any other number is a different take of the same song.

input.name: title
input.label: Title (names the file)
input.help: Names the .flac in Desktop\make_music\songs; not sent to the model. Empty lets the runner name it.

input.name: cot
input.label: Mode (cot) - how it composes
input.help: full = plan + melody first, then sing (best; the planning stage alone is ~25 min). melody = skip the written plan, faster, structure looser. off = straight to audio (fastest, for auditioning a sound).

input.name: budget
input.label: Budget - VRAM ceiling (GiB)
input.help: The torch allocator ceiling, not the song length. 16 = 13.98 GiB usable on this card (the pipeline keeps a 2 GiB reserve); 14 = 12 GiB, 12 = 10 GiB, 10 = 8 GiB for small tests.

fits.note: plan + melody pass - the best mode, and the slowest; 16 GiB ceiling proven here

HF_HOME=C:/AI/hf-cache; fetch YuE2-3B (7,261,441,640 B) and yue-vae

hints.do: take the audio.cpp Q4_0 route (yue2-3b-q4_0.gguf, 2.67 GB) instead of torch
hints.why: the torch route wants a 12 GB ceiling and the whole card; the GGUF route runs inside 6 GB
hints.reconsider: a card of 12 GB or more should use torch - it is the better quality ceiling, so do not route a big card through Q4
hints.learned: 2026-11-05: weights downloading on a GTX 980 Ti, no run yet - the RTF is unknown, not good

hints.when: the model card says diffusers or torch-only
hints.do: check the audio.cpp family list before ruling the node out
hints.why: the pure ggml binary reaches cards the torch stack cannot address at all (Maxwell reports fp16:0)
hints.reconsider: if a modern CUDA card is free, torch has the better ceiling and the newer model - ggml is the floor, not the goal
hints.evidence: audiocpp_cli --list-devices on GTX 980 Ti (fp16:0) and GTX 1660 SUPER (fp16:1, no matrix cores)

exceptions.do: upload a .ps1 and run it with -File; never inline -Command
exceptions.why: inline quoting splits on names with = or :, and $_ is eaten by the shell before PowerShell sees it
exceptions.reconsider: pwsh 7 on both ends removes both problems

exceptions.when: chatterbox is the chosen family instead of yue2
exceptions.do: pass --voice-ref - it has no default voice
exceptions.why: audio.cpp answers "Chatterbox prepare requires speaker reference audio" and exits 1
exceptions.reconsider: a design-family model (qwen3_tts VoiceDesign) needs no reference at all - reach for cloning only when a recorded voice is the point

output.description: one FLAC per run; the full pipeline log stays in the run output (plan pass, song pass, token rates)

pages.ad:
YuE — words become a song

YuE2-3B · RX 6800 · one song per run · this node

Give it a genre and lyrics. It sings them, with a band, and honours the structure markers you write. Karma 4

What it makes

One complete song — vocals plus instruments — as a FLAC in the songs folder. Length is your lyrics' doing, not a setting: about 2.5–3 s of audio per line.

What it needs here

  • The RX 6800 for the whole run, and nobody else on it: stop the image or video service first.
  • 24 GB of RAM; the predictor is memory-hungry at mode full.
  • The venv at C:/AI/yue-venv and the model at C:/AI/hf/YuE2-3B.

What it costs

~90 minutes for a ~5 minute song in full mode. Melody mode is faster and thinner; off is direct and thinnest. There is no queue — one run at a time.

Where the output lands

Desktop\\make_music\\songs\\<title>__YuE2-3B.flac

How to start it

Prepare this serve, paste style and lyrics, press run. The old studio server at :8090 is retired — this page is that page now.
pages.inputs:
What a run does

yue-song.ps1 -Style ... -Lyrics ... -Seed ... -Cot ... -Budget ... -Title ...
      -> writes outputs<job>.request.json
      -> python -m yue2.cli generate --model C:\AI\hf\YuE2-3B --vae C:\AI\hf\yue-vae --budget 16 --offload-ar
      -> outputs<job><job>\audio.flac
      -> copies to Desktop\make_music\songs<title>__YuE2-3B.flac

The studio page is gone as a server; this is the same six knobs, one run per song. Nothing stays running afterwards.

Reading the run

The pipeline prints [YuE2] Running <stage>: N tokens, X tokens/s, elapsed per stage, then Completed: 300.4s audio in .... The run is over when the FLAC lands.

Before you press run

Close the browser and stop any miner, llama-server or sd-server. YuE wants the whole card and a lot of RAM — a second GPU user does not make it slower, it makes it fail.

One song at a time. A second run is refused until the first ends.

progress.how: yue2.cli prints "[YuE2] Running <stage>: N tokens, X tokens/s, elapsed" per stage, then "Completed: <seconds>s audio in <seconds>s", then the copy line
